# Chile Help Topics

Chile Help Topics (16 pages): Chile Help Topics

## Chapters
- [Chile Help Topics](article_8151402336.md): Overview The following help topics provide information about NetSuite features that are specific to companies doing business in Chile.
  - [Chile Terminology](article_0703033654.md): The following table defines the terms used in NetSuite to support Chile-specific business processes: | BCI | Banco de Crédito e inversiones (Bank of Credit and Investments).
  - [Setting Up Chile-specific Preferences](article_0703034654.md): In NetSuite, set up your company and personal user preferences that are specific to doing business in Chile.
  - [Chile Tax Topics](article_0704011014.md): The Chile Localization SuiteApp provides custom fields, records, validations, and other customizations for Chilean businesses to comply with tax in Chile.
  - [Chile Localization](article_7101947784.md): To use the Chile Localization SuiteApp, read the following topics: - Chile Localization SuiteApp Installation(https://docs.
